question: How many movies are in the database?
What movies were released after 2015?
expected_sql: SELECT title FROM movies WHERE release_year > 2015;

question: Which movies were directed by Christopher Nolan?
expected_sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_directors md ON m.movie_id = md.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.director_id WHERE d.name = 'Christopher Nolan';

question: Which directors have the highest average movie rating?
expected_sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM directors d JOIN movie_directors md ON d.director_id = md.director_id JOIN ratings r ON md.movie_id = r.movie_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;

question: Which genre has the highest average rating?
expected_sql: SELECT g.name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM genres g JOIN movie_genres mg ON g.genre_id = mg.genre_id JOIN ratings r ON mg.movie_id = r.movie_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 1;
